tests.name: All three project templates survive JSON export/import
Duplicate identities and dangling terminals rejected
Reversed duplicate cable rejected
Start, retention after release, and stop in relay circuit and PLC
Short between supply poles stops simulation
Ladder unknown contact and input coil produce diagnostics
TON reaches preset and resets when input drops
TOF holds after input drops and expires at preset
CTU counts edges instead of scans
ST boolean conditions, arithmetic precedence and comments
ST rejects unknown names, type errors, loops and input assignment
ST division by zero fails explicitly
Automatic tank reaches high level and turns pump off
Drain returns to low level and pump restarts
Tank volume follows inflow minus outflow
Default LED circuit current agrees with resistor and diode model
Reversed LED does not light
Breadboard columns connected internally; channel and split rails separated
Shorted breadboard source detected before solving
Floating circuit has no fabricated voltage
Nodal solver handles series and parallel resistors
LED without limiting resistor produces overcurrent warning
Invalid versions, JSON, holes, nonfinite values and mismatched widget types rejected
Resistance labels use ohms, kilo and mega with decimal comma
Resistance input: decimal comma, scale and thousands are never confused; values are stored in ohms
Resistor bands are computed only when the value is exactly representable with two digits
Confirmed resistor edit to 4,7 kΩ is stored as 4700 and the solver uses it; reference stays 3,069 mA
Value labels sit in hole-free lanes, away from legs, wires and each other
Puente H con L293D (Práctica 2): sentido de giro, habilitación, conflictos y validación
Transistor NPN 2N2222: corte, región activa (Ic = β·Ib) y saturación
Transistor en la protoboard: base en el orificio del medio, validación y advertencias
Práctica 1 (puente H con cuatro 2N2222): S1 y S2 invierten el giro; ambos juntos provocan cortocircuito del puente
Óhmetro: sin energía, resistencia en serie, circuito abierto, cortocircuito y LED (OL a 0,4 V)
Valores reales: tolerancia estable por pieza, ±5 % en resistencias y lectura distinta del valor nominal
Amperímetro en serie, en paralelo y fusible; fallas por sobreesfuerzo y protección de la fuente
Transistor PNP (2N2907) y diodo 1N4007: polaridad, regiones y corriente
Reubicar componentes: extremos libres, transistor y L293D conservan su forma y no pisan otras patas
Cable del multímetro: cuelga con holgura, conserva su longitud, reacciona al mover la punta y se asienta

scope: Own local educational models; no physical hardware, manufacturer PLC or UNIFCAD PRO validation.
